# Vendored Markdown renderer

markdown-it 15.0.3, MIT. Browser UMD bundle and original license copied from the official npm tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz

Tarball SHA-512 (base64): +Az7Ojz3iRGu8KYMvJ6xVhvrxP3eE+vEtJX75Ow88XBpcQNV/0lGX5ZynIIBftREo4DC2jsveAMDaeltmm8QvQ==

Served locally; no runtime CDN or build-tool dependency. PickyLens disables HTML/images and allows only HTTP(S)/mailto links; no syntax highlighting or third-party plugins. Renderer output alone is inserted as HTML. The original answer remains unchanged.
